title: About Kancara
subtitle: Your Travel Companion
description: Kancara is here to help you plan and manage your travels more easily. We believe that every trip should be an unforgettable experience. This app is built by travelers for travelers.
missionText: To provide the best tools for planning dream vacations, exploring new destinations, and sharing precious moments without friction.
visionText: To be the premier platform for travelers to realize organized, safe, and enjoyable journeys.
historyText: Born this year out of a personal frustration with complicated travel planning, Kancara is our fresh take on making journeys seamless. We are just getting started, and our passion is to build the ultimate tool for travelers everywhere.
value1Desc: We encourage curiosity and discovering the unknown.
value2Desc: Travel planning should be intuitive and straightforward.
value3Desc: We believe in the power of shared experiences.
ctaText: Be among the first to explore the world with Kancara.
